title: Unused-Term Credit Methods Keyed to the Timing of the Latest Tailwise Plus Fee
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus — the unused-term credit on a move up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual.** The credit is produced by one of three methods, judged from the latest membership fee charge on the rewards history: its charge date, and the first day of the billing period it pays for.

1. **Fee charged after the first day of its billing period.** The credit is that fee times the unused days — from the change date through the term end date, both counted — divided by the days from that fee's charge date through the term end date, both days counted.
2. **Fee charged on the first day of its billing period, and the change date at most 30 days after that charge.** The credit is that whole fee.
3. **Otherwise.** The credit is that fee times the unused days, divided by the days of the current term from its start date through its end date, both days counted — prorated by calendar day and never below zero.

**Both sides of the 30-day line (hypothetical, fee charged on 1 January, the first day of its period).** Change on 31 January (30 days after): the whole fee. Change on 1 February (31 days after): method 3.

**Worked figures (hypothetical, term 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026, fee $59.00, change on 2 July 2026; 183 unused days).**

| Latest fee charge | Method | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| charged 15 January, period starting 1 January | 1 — 59.00 times 183 divided by 351 (15 January through 31 December) | $30.7607 |
| charged 1 January, period starting 1 January, change on 20 January | 2 | $59.00 |
| charged 1 January, period starting 1 January | 3 — 59.00 times 183 divided by 365 | $29.5808 |
